limits: All-adult arrivals are an explicit initial condition, not a demographic equilibrium.
Model water loss is not a measured complete human requirement.
A larger catchment ratio is not calibrated carrying capacity.
Opening food and standing tissue are not annual edible productivity.
Later 14-day changed-bundle comparison retains all arrivals with cooler camp centers and more food stock. No isolated causal attribution or seasonal adequacy result is established.

limits: Metabolic power and potential chemical energy are not measured heat fluxes or predicted temperatures.
16 m²/person and 0.5 m pile height are uncalibrated model parameters.
